summary: Trusted in-process hooks now expose cooperative deadline/cancellation semantics without claiming physical termination of arbitrary Python callbacks.

delegated_review.reason: The changed C6 files were uncommitted and therefore were not materialized in the isolated Zetsu worktree; exact local verification completed in Codex.

previous_phase_regression.command: C0-C5 corrective and affected repository/runtime regression suite

combined_c0_c6.command: C0-C6 corrective and affected repository/runtime regression suite

security_notes: A timed-out callback receives a cooperative cancellation signal and its result is never authoritative.
The bounded pool prevents one ignored callback per timeout from creating an unbounded thread population.
Pre-hook failures remain fail-closed and post-hook failures remain observational.
No callback process or thread is represented as physically terminated when Python cannot guarantee that fact.
